title: Derive canonical replacement without importing collapse
statement: Reality-level record formation is not established until the kernel derives a native many-to-one effective transition that converts unresolved alternatives into one persistent distinguishable record without importing a measurement postulate, Bell/Born target, thermal bath, Hamiltonian, temperature, or external random selector.

partner_memory_blocking.result: p_block(N)=1/(2N-3) for the explicitly specified uniform random-pair scheduler
partner_memory_blocking.warning: Do not identify 1/5 or its N-scaling with a measured natural constant.

swap_hamiltonian.result: H=J P_swap preserves singlet weight because [H,P_-]=0
swap_hamiltonian.warning: Switching J to zero can stop interaction but does not select or purify an already entangled state.

landauer.result: beta Q = h + DeltaI + D under the stated open-system assumptions
landauer.warning: Landauer constrains the cost of logically irreversible erasure/reset; it does not choose an outcome.

target.name: canonical_replacement
target.required_effect: At the effective record level, at least two previously distinguishable admissible alternatives map to one persistent record class.
target.required_provenance: The transition rule must be derived from existing native primitives or be reported as MISSING_OPERATOR. A newly proposed primitive must be labelled non-native and must not count as closure.
required_output: proof or exhaustive finite certificate of many-to-one behavior
proof that the selected record is persistent under the declared future dynamics
explicit distinction between record formation and outcome selection
information-flow ledger showing what is exported, retained, or erased
at least one parameter-free observable generated before external comparison

forbidden_shortcuts: Treat decoherence or reduced-state diagonalisation as single-outcome selection.
Use Landauer heat as an outcome selector.
Insert projective measurement or Born sampling as the missing operator.
Import a thermal bath, beta, k_B T, Hamiltonian, metric, spacetime dimension, Standard Model group, CODATA value, or target natural constant as a seed.
Use pi-pattern numerology or post-hoc matching to known constants.
Add external randomness without deriving its physical status.
Call a coarse-graining or observer ignorance map fundamental erasure without tracking the global record.
kill_criteria: If all native transitions remain one-to-one on the complete autonomous state, canonical replacement is not derived.
If apparent many-to-one behavior disappears after omitted environment/controller/history variables are restored, fail.
If a unique outcome requires an externally supplied selector, fail.
If the only quantitative output is a scheduler-dependent algorithmic ratio with no independently defined physical observable, do not promote it to a natural constant.
If the construction requires the thermodynamic quantities it claims to derive, fail for circularity.
success_criterion: A frozen kernel generates a new parameter-free observable or distribution from the native transition law; the value is sealed before any external measurement/lookup and is subsequently testable.
research_question: Does the existing Faecher grammar already contain a derivation path to canonical_replacement, or does exhaustive closure return MISSING_OPERATOR?
